company_active_domain_unique.name: company_active_domain_unique
company_active_domain_unique.where: "company"."archived_at" is null and "company"."domain" is not null

contact_active_email_unique.name: contact_active_email_unique
contact_active_email_unique.where: "contact"."archived_at" is null and "contact"."email" is not null

activity_anchor_check.name: activity_anchor_check
activity_anchor_check.value: (("activity"."company_id" is not null) + ("activity"."contact_id" is not null) + ("activity"."deal_id" is not null) + ("activity"."lead_id" is not null) + ("activity"."product_id" is not null) + ("activity"."order_id" is not null)) >= 1

crm_file_ready_check.name: crm_file_ready_check
crm_file_ready_check.value: ("crm_file"."status" = 'ready' and "crm_file"."ready_at" is not null) or ("crm_file"."status" != 'ready' and "crm_file"."ready_at" is null)

custom_field_value_one_record_check.name: custom_field_value_one_record_check
custom_field_value_one_record_check.value: (("custom_field_value"."company_id" is not null) + ("custom_field_value"."contact_id" is not null) + ("custom_field_value"."deal_id" is not null) + ("custom_field_value"."lead_id" is not null) + ("custom_field_value"."product_id" is not null) + ("custom_field_value"."order_id" is not null)) = 1

lead_conversion_state.name: lead_conversion_state
lead_conversion_state.value: ("lead"."converted_at" is null and "lead"."converted_contact_id" is null and "lead"."status_id" != 'converted') or ("lead"."converted_at" is not null and "lead"."converted_contact_id" is not null and "lead"."status_id" = 'converted')

product_variant_sku.name: product_variant_sku
product_variant_sku.value: "product_variant"."sku" is null or length(trim("product_variant"."sku")) between 1 and 100

product_variant_cost.name: product_variant_cost
product_variant_cost.value: "product_variant"."cost_minor" is null or (typeof("product_variant"."cost_minor")='integer' and "product_variant"."cost_minor" between 0 and 99999999999999)

product_variant_duration.name: product_variant_duration
product_variant_duration.value: "product_variant"."duration_minutes" is null or (typeof("product_variant"."duration_minutes")='integer' and "product_variant"."duration_minutes" between 1 and 1000000)

sales_order_money.name: sales_order_money
sales_order_money.value: "sales_order"."goods_minor">=0 and "sales_order"."discount_minor" between 0 and "sales_order"."goods_minor" and "sales_order"."surcharge_minor">=0 and "sales_order"."tax_minor">=0 and "sales_order"."original_minor"="sales_order"."goods_minor"-"sales_order"."discount_minor"+"sales_order"."surcharge_minor"+"sales_order"."tax_minor" and "sales_order"."original_minor"<=99999999999999

sales_order_remaining.name: sales_order_remaining
sales_order_remaining.value: "sales_order"."goods_remaining_minor" between 0 and "sales_order"."goods_minor"-"sales_order"."discount_minor" and "sales_order"."surcharge_remaining_minor" between 0 and "sales_order"."surcharge_minor" and "sales_order"."tax_remaining_minor" between 0 and "sales_order"."tax_minor"
